Pro Tip: When using a green screen make sure you have proper lighting. It will cost a bit to get the right lights but this can be done on the cheap by using high voltage drop lights. By positioning the lights to get rid of the shadows will making keying out the green much easier and will help prevent the flickering around the subject.

You can also go even cheaper by putting a bright light behind you. It'll warm the shit out of your back but it will also help get rid of the shadows on the green screen.
